queries.query: Kindu Democratic Republic of Congo cadastral parcel map GIS official cadastre
queries.result: Search found national DRC cadastral/land-registry procedure pages, the national Ministry of Land Affairs site, and general national GIS/planning portals. No Kindu-local official parcel viewer or public parcel geometry endpoint was identified.

registryEvidence.basis: The DRC public-service catalogue describes formal consultation through the Conservateur des Titres Immobiliers or Chef de Division du Cadastre and the Ministry site describes national cadastral administration and digitization. Neither establishes a Kindu-local public registry endpoint or map service.

requests.outcome: Bureau d'Informations Cadastrales landing page returned HTML. Its page advertises cadastral/land information, but no anonymous Kindu query, public schema, CRS, stable parcel identity, or geometry response was exposed. The page JavaScript was inspected for public routes; no usable parcel API was verified.

Current BIC JavaScript bundle retrieved and inspected. It contained application/UI references but no verified anonymous Kindu parcel request route. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, or unsafe fields were attempted.

Official Ministry of Land Affairs site returned HTML. It documents cadastral administration, fees/procedures, and a pilot digitization/archive project; no public city-bounded parcel API or geometry response was exposed.

Official National Statistics Institute cartography page returned HTML and states its GIS module is in development/not yet available. It describes province/territory indicators, not cadastral parcels; no parcel schema or geometry obtained.

Official SGAT portal returned HTML and exposes general planning/cartography sections and a Kindu-related planning-work item. No public parcel layer, service configuration, schema, CRS, or parcel geometry response was exposed.
Official ANAT services page returned HTML and describes national spatial-planning/GIS expertise and a data-portal concept. No anonymous Kindu parcel request or parcel geometry was verified.

Official public-service catalogue page returned HTML. It describes paid formal consultation of cadastral/land registers through the responsible land-office officials; it is a procedure description, not an open parcel map/API. Owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, and personal fields were not requested.
